edges.mechanism: Oral DHEA is aromatized to estrogens (estradiol +7.86 pg/mL in postmenopausal women); additive estrogen exposure with HT; potential additive/antagonistic effects listed for estrogens.
edges.evidence: MA of 21 studies plus drug review; no direct interaction trial; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Potential additive or antagonistic sex-steroid effects; DHEA plus oral contraceptives altered bone outcomes in anorexia nervosa.
edges.evidence: Drug review; SR of RCTs in anorexia nervosa; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: DHEA raises testosterone (WMD +28 ng/dL, larger >50 mg/d and in women); additive androgenic exposure and adverse effects.
edges.evidence: Dose-response MA of RCTs plus drug review

edges.mechanism: Vaginal DHEA did not raise estradiol in women on AIs but raised DHEA-S and testosterone; systemic oral DHEA with AIs unstudied and could supply aromatase substrate.
edges.evidence: Secondary analysis of RCT (n=345) and 10-patient pilot

edges.mechanism: DHEA is converted to DHT via 5-alpha-reductase; potential pharmacodynamic interaction with finasteride/dutasteride.
edges.evidence: Theoretical, drug-monograph review

edges.mechanism: Exogenous glucocorticoids suppress endogenous DHEA-S and reduce its diagnostic accuracy for adrenal insufficiency; prasterone was trialed for bone protection in glucocorticoid-treated SLE.
edges.evidence: Cohort (n=1135) and drug review

edges.mechanism: Small reduction in fasting plasma glucose (WMD -2.19 mg/dL) without insulin/HOMA-IR change.
edges.evidence: MA of 14 publications; low certainty

edges.mechanism: DHEA has neurosteroid activity and has been used as antipsychotic augmentation; case reports of DHEA-associated mania.
edges.evidence: Small RCT and case reports

edges.mechanism: Ashwagandha raised DHEA-S 18% and testosterone 14.7% vs placebo; stacking may add androgen exposure and confound DHEA-S monitoring.
edges.evidence: Single crossover RCT of ashwagandha; no combination study

edges.mechanism: Both used as IVF adjuvants in poor/diminished ovarian response; network MA ranks both above control; DOR MA found combined supplement use correlated with better ovarian markers.
edges.evidence: Network MA and MA of mostly low-quality studies

edges.mechanism: Vitamin D3 plus calcium was background in both arms of DHEA bone trials; spine BMD gains in older women occurred on this background (interaction not tested).
edges.evidence: RCTs with co-administration; very low certainty for interaction

edges.mechanism: Estrogen is a metabolite of prasterone; systemic DHEA raises estradiol; higher endogenous DHEA/DHEA-S/estradiol associated with postmenopausal breast cancer risk.
edges.evidence: FDA label warning; MA of RCTs; pooled prospective cohorts

edges.mechanism: DHEA is converted to testosterone/DHT; adrenal-permissive HSD3B1 allele that increases DHEA-to-androgen flux is linked to worse outcomes in advanced prostate cancer.
edges.evidence: Mechanistic and genetic-association review; precautionary

edges.mechanism: Case reports of mania (including severe) with onset during DHEA use.
edges.evidence: Case reports; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Androgenic adverse effects (mainly acne) OR 3.77 vs placebo in menopausal women; acne RR 2.2 in SLE.
edges.evidence: Cochrane reviews

edges.mechanism: DHEA monotherapy did not improve BMD and one study suggested detrimental BMD effects in younger adolescents with open physes.
edges.evidence: SR of 7 RCTs

edges.with: low HDL / cardiovascular risk in women
edges.mechanism: DHEA lowered HDL-C (-5.1 mg/dL in women), TC/LDL/TG unchanged.
edges.evidence: Dose-response MA of RCTs; low certainty

edges.mechanism: DHEA is an optional adjunct, not a substitute for glucocorticoid/mineralocorticoid replacement; HRQOL benefit small; guidelines advise against routine use.
edges.evidence: MA of 10 RCTs and Endocrine Society guidelines

edges.mechanism: DHEA-S cross-reacts in many direct testosterone immunoassays (Abbott Architect, Roche Elecsys, Beckman Access, Immulite), falsely raising measured testosterone in DHEA users; LC-MS/MS avoids this.
edges.evidence: Spiking studies and UK NEQAS external quality assessment

edges.mechanism: Exogenous DHEA raises serum DHEA-S, which is used as a screening marker for adrenal insufficiency and could mask a low value (inferred).
edges.evidence: Diagnostic cohorts of DHEA-S for AI; masking inferred, not directly studied

edges.mechanism: True increases in estradiol, estrone, testosterone and DHEA-S and decreased SHBG with oral DHEA; vaginal DHEA 6.5 mg/d raised DHEA-S, testosterone and estradiol in cancer survivors.
edges.evidence: RCTs and MA

edges.mechanism: DHEA is WADA-prohibited; urinary DHEA >100 ng/mL triggers isotope-ratio MS confirmation of exogenous steroid.
edges.evidence: Anti-doping laboratory data and review

edges.mechanism: Adrenal-permissive allele yields stable 3beta-HSD1 and greater conversion of DHEA to potent androgens; response to supplemental DHEA untested.
edges.evidence: Mechanistic/genetic review
